name: Jasper
summary: Marketing AI for on-brand copy, campaigns, and content workflows.
description: Jasper is the marketing platform for writing and campaign work. It is not Jasper's image product (Image Pipelines, filed as Jasper Art). On 21 October 2026 its pricing page listed two plans: Pro at $69 per seat each month, or $59 per seat each month billed annually, and Business at a custom price. There is no ongoing free plan. A 7-day Pro trial asks for a card and converts to paid if it is not cancelled.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Listed Free; jasper.ai/pricing: Pro $69/month/seat ($59 yearly), 7-day free trial, no free plan

features: Content Generation: Creates high-quality marketing copy and blog posts.
Tone Customization: Adjusts writing style to match brand voice.
SEO Optimization: Ensures content is optimized for search engines.
Team Collaboration: Enables multiple users to work on content together.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Log In
howToUse.description: Register on Jasper and access the content dashboard.

howToUse.title: Select Content Type
howToUse.description: Choose blog, ad copy, image, or business writing.

howToUse.title: Provide Details & Prompts
howToUse.description: Input your topic, brand voice, and any special requirements.

howToUse.title: Generate, Edit & Export
howToUse.description: Review content, refine as needed, and export for marketing or business use.

features_fr: Génération de contenu : crée des textes marketing et des articles de blog de haute qualité.
Personnalisation du votre : ajuste le style d'écriture pour correspondre à la voix de la marque.
Optimisation SEO : garantit que le contenu est optimisé pour les moteurs de recherche.
Collaboration en équipe : permet à plusieurs utilisateurs de travailler ensemble sur le contenu.
